scholarships.name: President's Scholarship of Distinction (admission average of 95% or higher)
scholarships.description: The $1,500 International Experience Award will be awarded to Distinction Scholars who participate in an international study or work experience.
eligibility: Your early May admission average, including required courses, must be 95% or higher for the program for which you’ve received and accepted an offer of admission.
You must be enrolled at Waterloo in full-time degree studies for the entire September to December term.

If you receive a scholarship before May, you must meet all the conditions specified above. Once we’ve reviewed your grades available in early May, we’ll confirm your University of Waterloo President’s or Merit Scholarship. You will be able to view the scholarship information in the applicant portal.
